summary: An applied group read carries the record's head and revision, the arrangement with every group's field count, and the fields of the group asked for.

then.note: record.sections carries every section and group, so the panel draws its tabs and its skeleton to size at once; only the group `about` carries its fields, every other group carries `fields` empty and its `field_count`. An empty `fields` with a count is a group not read yet, never an empty group.
